capital.evidence_quote: Harare is the capital and largest commercial metropolis of Zimbabwe

currency.evidence_quote: Zimbabwe Gold (ZiG) is the official currency; US dollars circulate widely and are preferred in tourism

sources.title: Office of the President and Cabinet of Zimbabwe

timezone.evidence_quote: Zimbabwe operates on Central Africa Time UTC+2 without daylight saving adjustments

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard domestic voltage across Zimbabwe is 220V single-phase alternating current at 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Electrical power grid alternating frequency is 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Wall outlets in Zimbabwe accommodate British three-pin Type G and round-pin Type D plugs

police.evidence_quote: Dial 995 for emergency police services across Zimbabwe

sources.title: Ministry of Health and Child Care of Zimbabwe

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 994 or private EMS (MARS) for emergency medical ambulance dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 993 for municipal fire and technical rescue brigades

general.evidence_quote: 112 serves as the primary cellular emergency dispatch number

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Victoria Falls Tourist Police unit dedicated 24/7 post assists international park visitors

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Viktorya Şelaleleri ve safari milli parkları son derece güvenlidir; başkentte olağan yankesicilik önlemleri alınmalıdır.
advisory_headline.en: Victoria Falls and safari parks are exceptionally secure; exercise normal caution against petty theft in cities.
advisory_headline.de: Victoriafälle und Nationalparks sind sehr sicher; in Städten auf Taschendiebstahl achten.
advisory_headline.ru: Водопад Виктория и сафари-парки полностью безопасны; в городах соблюдайте осторожность от карманных краж.
advisory_headline.es: Las Cataratas Victoria y parques de safari son muy seguros; tome precauciones habituales en ciudades.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Zimbabwe measure approximately 24.2 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Zimbabwe reach 36.5 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: US Dollar cash (printed after 2013, clean and unblemished) is universally accepted and strongly preferred for visas, park entrance fees, and dining. Econet Wireless and NetOne provide tourist eSIMs.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Econet delivers extensive 4G cellular and roaming services across Victoria Falls and Harare

local_apps.name: EcoCash
local_apps.description: Zimbabwe's dominant mobile money platform for cashless local transactions.

local_apps.name: Vaya
local_apps.description: Popular ride-hailing app for booking vetted, licensed taxis in Harare and Bulawayo.

local_apps.name: Vic Falls Guide
local_apps.description: Offline guide app for rainforest trails, helicopter flight of angels bookings, and gorge viewpoints.

local_apps.name: Google Maps
local_apps.description: Reliable city navigation for Victoria Falls town and major highway routes.

tr.conditions: Türk vatandaşları Kategori B kapsamındadır; havalimanında Kapıda Vize (VoA - 30$, tek giriş) alabilir veya KAZA UniVisa ($50) ile Zambiya ve Zimbabve'ye birlikte geçiş yapabilir.

us.conditions: US citizens can obtain a 30-day tourist Visa on Arrival ($30 USD) or purchase the dual-country KAZA UniVisa ($50).

de.conditions: German and EU citizens receive a Visa on Arrival (Category B, $30) or KAZA UniVisa at ports of entry.

gb.conditions: British passport holders can purchase a Visa on Arrival ($55 USD) or eligible KAZA UniVisa upon entry.

ru.conditions: Граждане РФ получают визу по прибытии в аэропортах Хараре и Виктория-Фолс ($30) или оформляют KAZA UniVisa.

dos.title: Buy the KAZA UniVisa ($50) if visiting Victoria Falls
dos.description: The KAZA UniVisa allows unlimited border crossings between Zimbabwe and Zambia for 30 days to view the falls from both sides.

dos.title: Carry pristine US Dollar bills printed after 2013
dos.description: Torn, worn, or pre-2013 US dollar banknotes will be rejected at national park gates, hotels, and exchange counters.

dos.title: Wear a waterproof poncho in the Victoria Falls rainforest
dos.description: The spray from the 'Smoke that Thunders' (Mosi-oa-Tunya) creates torrential rainforest conditions along the cliff trail.

donts.title: Don't wear military camouflage clothing
donts.description: Wearing camouflage patterns or military attire is strictly illegal in Zimbabwe for civilians.

donts.title: Don't photograph police roadblocks or government buildings
donts.description: Photographing state house, police checkposts, or defense personnel is strictly prohibited.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10-15% in US Dollar cash is standard in Victoria Falls restaurants; tipping safari and rafting guides ($10/day) is customary.
